name: llmctx
description: Attach LLM context invisibly to your source files. Click to pack any file for pasting into any LLM.

commands.title: llmctx: Pack current file to clipboard
llmctx: Pack current file with the context of its imports
llmctx: Copy project map to clipboard
llmctx: Reindex current file (force Ollama regeneration)

llmctx.autoStartDaemon.description: Start the llmctxd daemon in the background when it is not already running.

llmctx.daemonPath.description: Absolute path to the llmctxd binary. Leave empty to use PATH resolution.

llmctx.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama base URL to use instead of llmcontext.yaml's. Needed for a remote Ollama: a repository's llmcontext.yaml may only point at this machine. Applies to CLI calls and to a daemon this extension starts (restart an already-running llmctxd to pick it up).

llmctx.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar to show the llmctx indicator.

llmctx.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the llmctx binary. Leave empty to use PATH resolution (recommended after running `cpctx setup`).
